purpose: Discharge or precisely bound the external-label residual of Paper II using a PUBLISHED third-party-labelled corpus, so that label author-independence holds mechanically. Every terminal below, including the negative and infeasibility terminals, is a first-class outcome; no terminal may be converted into another after outcome access.

corpus.name: ARN: Analogical Reasoning on Narratives
corpus.citation: Sourati, Ilievski, Sommerauer, Jiang. TACL 12:1063-1086, 2024. doi:10.1162/tacl_a_00688
corpus.label_authors: Sourati, Ilievski, Sommerauer, Jiang (ARN authors; system mappings derived from crowdworked ePiC proverb identity; RA validation on 120 items)
corpus.label_author_independence: Mechanical: none of the label authors is the reducer author. Recorded in SEARCH_LEDGER.md with provenance caveats (near analogies partially GPT-3.5-generated then author-edited).
corpus.contamination_note: Corpus public since 2023-10. The registered reducer is deterministic with no trained weights, so training contamination is not applicable. Author-knowledge channel mitigated by freezing the reducer before first dataset contact; the reducer contains no ARN-specific vocabulary.

order: freeze this protocol, the reducer module, the runner and their tests (this commit; before any dataset download on any host)

acquire the CSV on laptop billy; record sha256, byte size, header and first 3 rows verbatim in ACQUISITION_RECEIPT.json; bind column mapping per the frozen contingency table into MAPPING.json; no arm may be scored before MAPPING.json is written
run reducer admission (admit_reducer) on the frozen sample sources
write RESULT.json with the terminal; commit receipts unmodified
chronology.header_inspection_is_not_outcome_access: Reading the header and first 3 rows is schema binding, recorded verbatim; arm scores and gold-aggregate statistics are outcome access and occur only after admission and battery stages are configured.

schema_contingency.M1_one_row_per_triple: columns resolvable for query text, analogous-narrative text, distractor-narrative text, and near/far band(s) -> each row yields (query, analogy, ACCEPT) and (query, distractor, REJECT)
schema_contingency.M2_one_row_per_pair: columns resolvable for source text, candidate text, and an analogy/distractor label -> one labelled pair per row
schema_contingency.column_resolution: case-insensitive substring match over frozen keyword lists: query=['query'], analogy=['analog'], distractor=['distract','disanalog'], band=['near','far','distance','category','type'], group_id=['proverb','system','query_id','source_id']; ambiguous or unresolvable -> terminal CANNOT_CHECK__SCHEMA_MISMATCH with the header recorded verbatim

reducer.author: RAKL programme (same-context; LLM-assisted)
reducer.description: Stopword-filtered content tokens ranked by frequency (top 12, alphabetical tie-break) as roles; within-sentence consecutive role co-occurrence (window <= 4 tokens) as relations; sentences containing a frozen negation/contrast marker and >= 2 role tokens emit obstructions covering those roles; atoms = roles; edges from relations at cost 1.0, licensed_at 0.

admission.sample_sources: the query texts of the first 8 groups in frozen split order (recorded in the receipt)
admission.required_verdict: ADMITTED at CertificateKind.EXTERNAL_LABEL; REJECTED -> terminal ADMISSION_REJECTED; ADMITTED_AT_FLOOR is impossible by construction here and would indicate a profile defect -> terminal ADMISSION_REJECTED

pair_construction.accept_pairs: (query, analogous narrative), gold ACCEPT; band metadata retained (far-analogy pairs are the Q2 analogue)
pair_construction.reject_pairs: (query, distractor narrative), gold REJECT; band metadata retained (near-distractor pairs are the Q3 analogue)

split.grouping: by group_id column when resolvable, else by sha256(query text); groups sorted by sha256(group_key + ':20260814')
split.dev_use: threshold fitting only (theta_w, theta_l) and strongest-control selection
split.confirm_use: all battery probes and confirmatory gates; no threshold may be refit on confirm

arms.witness: reduce query -> ProblemStructure(required_roles, required_relations, qoi='analogical_support'); reduce candidate -> singleton StructureSpace; run src/rakl/structure_space.py::match. CANNOT_CHECK iff either side has < 2 roles or 0 relations (insufficient extraction evidence). REJECT iff match verdict is REJECTED. Else coverage_ratio = (|covered_roles| + 2*|covered_relations|) / (|required_roles| + 2*|required_relations|); ACCEPT iff coverage_ratio >= theta_w else REJECT. theta_w fit on DEV over grid 0.05..0.95 step 0.05 maximizing decidable exact accuracy, frozen before confirm scoring.
arms.lexical_control: Jaccard over stopword-filtered content tokens; ACCEPT iff >= theta_l (DEV grid 0.02..0.98 step 0.02); never abstains
arms.band_control: ACCEPT iff the pair's band metadata is 'near' (dataset-author surface-similarity annotation used as a predictor; context arm)
arms.strongest_control_rule: the non-witness arm with maximum DEV decidable exact accuracy; selected on DEV, frozen, then used as the paired comparator on CONFIRM
arms.gold_isolation: no arm receives the gold field; the runner passes texts and band metadata only, asserted at call time

scoring.primary_statistic: mean per-pair binary Brier(strongest control) minus mean per-pair binary Brier(witness) over all CONFIRM pairs

battery.B1_gold_arm_distinctness: runtime assertion that arm callables never receive the gold field; any violation -> BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE
battery.B2_text_destruction: character-scramble both texts of every CONFIRM pair (seed 20260814): the witness arm's (decision, structure-signature) must change on >= 50% of pairs, and scrambled witness exact accuracy must be <= the upper edge of the shuffled-gold null band; scramble-invariance -> BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE
battery.B3_shuffled_gold_negative_control: shuffle gold labels over CONFIRM (seed 20260815) and rerun G1: it must FAIL (CI includes 0 or advantage < MDE); if it passes -> BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE
battery.B4_trivial_arm_floor: no trivial arm may attain the G2 joint property; if one does -> BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE
battery.B5_paired_variance: per-pair Brier loss variance must be > 0 in both compared arms; else BATTERY_FAILED__INSTRUMENT_NOT_PROBATIVE
battery.probe_H_matched_pair: NOT APPLICABLE: no self-authored renderer; all surfaces are third-party. Recorded as N/A with this reason.

gates.G1_advantage: primary statistic >= MDE with bootstrap CI excluding zero
gates.G2_joint_property: witness valid_accept >= 0.60 AND invalid_false_accept <= 0.20 on CONFIRM, reported as a pair, with per-quadrant breakdown (far-analogy retention = Q2 analogue; near-distractor false-accept = Q3 analogue) always reported together
gates.G3_abstention_accounting: witness CANNOT_CHECK rate on CONFIRM reported; if > 0.50 the epoch terminal is NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT with reason ABSTENTION_DOMINANT (an honest incapacity measurement, not a gate rescue)

terminal_rules.POSITIVE_SCOPED__EXTERNAL_LABEL: admission ADMITTED, battery pass, G1 pass, G2 pass, G3 <= 0.50
terminal_rules.NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT: admission ADMITTED, battery pass, and (G1 CI upper bound < MDE, or G2 fail, or G3 > 0.50)
terminal_rules.INDETERMINATE__CI_STRADDLES_MDE: admission ADMITTED, battery pass, G1 CI contains MDE without the advantage clearing it
terminal_rules.no_post_result_rescue: thresholds, arms, gates and terminals may not be modified after outcome access; a successor epoch is a new versioned object

nonclaims: independent review (this epoch is same-context analysis over third-party labels)
